name: Carousel / Product Tour
description: Product Tour product scenario for the Carousel component.

controls.name: children
controls.description: The slides in order, one per top-level child: elements, text, or JSON `Media` descriptors.

controls.name: index
controls.description: Position shown (controlled): the index of the first visible slide, from 0; past the last position shows the last.

controls.name: defaultIndex
controls.description: Position shown on mount (uncontrolled), from 0; later changes are ignored.

controls.name: slidesPerView
controls.description: Slides visible side by side, a whole number from 1; each takes that share of the width. Default: 1.

controls.name: loop
controls.description: Previous and next, by control, key or swipe, wrap around at the ends instead of stopping there.

controls.name: autoPlay
controls.description: Advances one position per interval, after the last back to the first; any press or focus inside stops it, hover pauses it.

controls.name: autoPlayInterval
controls.description: Milliseconds each position shows before autoplay advances, from 100. Default: 3000.

controls.name: labels
controls.description: Names of the carousel's controls and slides, and the kinds they announce.

controls.name: aria-label
controls.description: Names the carousel region; without it and `aria-labelledby` the name is "Carousel".
